_comment: Sign-off: write after the memo review. verdict is proceed, proceed_with_conditions or stop. conditions are required for proceed_with_conditions (each with text, owner and due). Give at least one agreement or override. traced_conclusion names one source (an id in discovery_results.json), one dotted field in its record (for example temporal.end), and what could change the conclusion (at least 20 characters). Copy to outputs/<ID>/signoff.json.

agreements.reason: Why you agree with the agent here

traced_conclusion.could_change_if: The condition or open question that would change this conclusion
